# Rabbithole

Browser document canvas with a paired local Codex bridge.
Run `npx @shlokkhemani/rabbithole bridge` and open its private pairing link.
Choose a model and reasoning. Claude Code and OpenCode execution are TODOs.
Documents stay in the browser; native history stays in Codex. Exports omit local session references.

https://rabbithole.ing/
https://rabbithole.ing/about/
https://github.com/shlokkhemani/rabbithole
https://github.com/shlokkhemani/rabbithole#run-the-browser-version-locally
